Ple  ORDER

The petitioner seeks a mandamus to direct the respondents 2 and 3 to make a reference under Section 20(1) of the Tamil Nadu Highways act, 2001 to appropriate Court, as per the representation dated 02.11.2023, seeking enhancement of compensation.

2. The petitioner's property, measuring an extent of 0.68 hectares (1940 square meters) in Survey Number 9/1B2(part), Sengadu Village, Sriperumbudur Taluk, Kancheepuram District was acquired for the purpose of Chennai Peripheral Road Project.
An Award was passed on 13.10.2022.

However,
the same was not communicated to the petitioner, nor sent to her address.
On coming to know about the same, the petitioner submitted an objection stating that the compensation awarded was not https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis commensurate with the market value.
The said representation has not been considered to date and therefore, the petitioner is before this Court.
A reference is sought to be made under Section 20(1) of the Tamil Nadu Highways Act, 2001.

Since the order was not communicated to the petitioner within time, he was not in a position to make a representation within the time stipulated under the Act and as soon as he had got into knowledge of the same, a representation was given which has been kept pending for over a year.
Hence, the petitioner is before this Court.
3. Heard the learned counsels on either side.

4. Section 20 of the Tamil Nadu Highways Act reads as follows:
20. Reference to Court.
(1)Any person aggrieved by the decision of the Collector, or the officer to whom the case was transferred, determining the amount may, within sixty days from the date of such decision, in so far as it affects him, by application to the Collector or the officer to whom the case was transferred, require that the matter be referred by https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis him for the determination of the Court as defined Hatim Shabbir Jamnarwala vs The District Collector on 5 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102082028/
2 in the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (Central Act I of 1894), and when any such application is made, the provisions of Part III of the said Act shall mutatis mutandis apply to further proceedings in respect thereof.
(2)The decision of the Court on such reference and subject only to such decision, the decision of the Collector determining the amount shall be final.
